name: lexidaily
description: A daily five-letter word puzzle you play inside ChatGPT, with spoiler-free hints and streaks.

interface.shortDescription: A daily word puzzle in chat
interface.longDescription: A new five-letter word every day. You have six tries: purple tiles are the right letter in the right spot, orange ones are in the word but somewhere else. Type on the board or just tell ChatGPT your guess. Stuck? Ask for a hint and ChatGPT gives you a cryptic nudge without spoiling the word. Keep your streak alive, then dig into the word's story once you've solved it.
capabilities: Guess on the board or in the chat

positive.expected_behavior: Opens today's LexiDaily board in the conversation, empty if the user hasn't guessed yet, with the puzzle number and the user's streak.

positive.description: Generic request for a word game
positive.prompt: I want to play a word game
positive.expected_behavior: Offers or opens LexiDaily and shows today's board.

positive.prompt: Let's play LexiDaily. My first guess is crane.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the board and scores CRANE: purple for the right letter in the right spot, orange for in the word elsewhere, gray for not in the word. The board updates and ChatGPT says how many tries are left.

positive.prompt: Give me a hint for today's LexiDaily
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives a short cryptic clue about today's word based on the user's board, without saying the word.
Shows the board with the user's stats: games played, win rate, current streak and best streak.

negative.description: A different word game the user is playing elsewhere
negative.prompt: Help me solve today's NYT Wordle

publication.release_notes: First release: daily five-letter word puzzle with board and chat guessing, spoiler-free hints, streaks and stats.
